source.text: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥דיְהוָ֣ה קְ֭רָאתִיךָ ח֣וּשָׁה לִּ֑י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה ק֝וֹלִ֗י בְּקָרְאִי־לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: A psalm of David. YHWH, I call to you; hurry to me; give ear to my voice when I call to you.

en.L: A psalm of David. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I call to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; hurry to me; give ear to my voice when I call to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: A psalm of David. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I am calling to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; come to me quickly. Hear my voice as I cry out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: A song of David. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I am calling to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Please come quickly and help me. Listen to me when I call out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Psaume de David. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appelle ; hâte-toi vers moi ; prête l’oreille à ma voix quand je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appelle.
fr.B: Un psaume de David. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que j’appelle ; viens vite vers moi. Écoute ma voix quand je crie vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Un chant de David. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appelle. Viens vite m’aider. Écoute-moi quand je crie vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninakuita; uharakishe kuja kwangu; usikilize sauti yangu ninapokuita.
sw.B: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninakuita; njoo kwangu upesi. Usikie sauti yangu ninapokulilia.
sw.R: Wimbo wa Daudi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninakuita. Tafadhali njoo upesi unisaidie. Unisikilize ninapokulilia.

es.L: Salmo de David. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} clamo; apresúrate a [venir a] mí; escucha mi voz cuando clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: Salmo de David. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} estoy llamando; ven pronto a mí. Oye mi voz cuando clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Canto de David. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} estoy llamando. Por favor, ven pronto a ayudarme. Escúchame cuando clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: [Một] thi thiên của Đa-vít. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin mau đến cùng tôi; xin lắng tai nghe tiếng tôi khi tôi kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Thi thiên của Đa-vít. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi đang kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin mau đến với tôi. Xin nghe tiếng tôi khi tôi kêu lên cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Bài ca của Đa-vít. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi đang kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin mau đến giúp tôi. Xin lắng nghe tôi khi tôi kêu lên cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 다윗의 시. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 주님께 부르짖습니다. 제게 속히 오십시오. 제가 주님께 부르짖을 때 제 목소리에 귀를 기울여 주십시오.
ko.B: 다윗의 시. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 주님을 부릅니다. 어서 제게 와 주십시오. 제가 주님께 부르짖을 때 제 목소리를 들어 주십시오.
ko.R: 다윗이 지은 노래. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 주님을 부르고 있습니다. 어서 오셔서 저를 도와주십시오. 제가 주님께 부르짖을 때 들어 주십시오.

pt.L: Salmo de Davi. {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, eu clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; apressa-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} [a vir] a mim; dá ouvidos à minha voz quando clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.B: Salmo de Davi. {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, estou clamando a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; vem depressa até mim. Ouve a minha voz quando grito a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: Canção de Davi. {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, estou chamando por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Por favor, vem depressa me ajudar. Escuta-me quando eu clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

am.L: የዳዊት መዝሙር። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ወደ አንተ እጠራለሁ፤ ወደ እኔ ፍጠን፤ ወደ አንተ ስጠራ ድምፄን አድምጥ።
am.B: የዳዊት መዝሙር። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ወደ አንተ እጣራለሁ፤ ፈጥነህ ወደ እኔ ና። ወደ አንተ ስጮኽ ድምፄን ስማ።
am.R: ዳዊት የዘመረው መዝሙር። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ወደ አንተ እጣራለሁ። እባክህ ፈጥነህ መጥተህ እርዳኝ። ወደ አንተ ስጣራ ስማኝ።

hi.L: दाऊद का भजन। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं तुझे पुकारता हूँ; मेरे पास फुर्ती से आ; जब मैं तुझे पुकारूँ, तब मेरी आवाज़ पर कान लगा।
hi.B: दाऊद का भजन। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं तुझे पुकार रहा हूँ; जल्दी मेरे पास आ। जब मैं तेरी दुहाई देता हूँ, तब मेरी आवाज़ सुन।
hi.R: दाऊद का गीत। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं तुझे पुकार रहा हूँ। कृपया जल्दी आकर मेरी सहायता कर। जब मैं तुझे पुकारता हूँ, तब मेरी सुन।

ru.L: Псалом Давида. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я взываю к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}; поспеши ко мне; внемли моему голосу, когда я взываю к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
ru.B: Псалом Давида. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я взываю к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}; скорее приди ко мне. Услышь мой голос, когда я кричу к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
ru.R: Песнь Давида. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я зову {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. Пожалуйста, поспеши ко мне на помощь. Выслушай меня, когда я кричу к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.

ja.L: ダビデの賛歌。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしはあなたを呼ぶ。急いでわたしのもとに来てください。わたしがあなたを呼ぶとき、わたしの声に耳を傾けてください。
ja.B: ダビデの賛歌。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしはあなたを呼んでいる。急いでわたしのところに来てください。あなたに叫び求めるわたしの声を、聞いてください。
ja.R: ダビデの歌。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしはあなたを呼んでいる。どうか早く来て、わたしを助けてください。あなたを呼ぶわたしの声を、聞いてください。

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: hurry to me: come quickly to help
decisions.reason: The same plea opens 22:20, 38:23 and 70:2: come quickly, because the danger is near.

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1.

decisions.choice: and help me
decisions.reason: Readable says why the psalmist asks God to come quickly (m2).

decisions.choice: apressa-te [a vir] a mim (L); vem depressa (B, R)
decisions.reason: The plea of 22:20, 38:23, 70:2 and 71:12 (m2), in the words their Portuguese gives it.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 141.
alternatives: spans like the English ones (from verse 1)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; the psalm speaks to God with तू.

decisions.choice: Псалом Давида (L, B); Песнь Давида (R)
decisions.reason: The title (m1) follows the Psalms terms note: mizmor is "псалом" at Literal and Balanced and "песнь" at Readable.

decisions.choice: Title mizmor ledavid "ダビデの賛歌" (L, B), "ダビデの歌" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter title forms (PSA-1).

decisions.choice: chushah li "どうか早く来て、わたしを助けてください" (R)
decisions.reason: Come quickly to help (m2); R supplies the help as the English R does (r-en-2).

source.text: תִּכּ֤וֹן תְּפִלָּתִ֣י קְטֹ֣רֶת לְפָנֶ֑יךָ מַֽשְׂאַ֥ת כַּ֝פַּ֗י מִנְחַת־עָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: May it be set, my prayer, [as] incense before you, [the] lifting of my palms [as an] offering of evening.

en.L: Let my prayer be set [as] incense before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, the lifting up of my hands [as the] evening offering.
en.B: Let my prayer stand before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} like incense, my lifted hands like the offering at evening.
en.R: Let my prayer come to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} like the sweet smoke of incense. Let my hands, raised to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in prayer, be like the offering given each evening.

fr.L: Que ma prière soit placée [comme] l’encens devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, l’élévation de mes mains [comme] l’offrande du soir !
fr.B: Que ma prière se tienne devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} comme l’encens, et mes mains levées comme l’offrande du soir !
fr.R: Que ma prière monte vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} comme la fumée parfumée de l’encens ! Que mes mains levées vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour prier soient comme l’offrande de chaque soir !

sw.L: Maombi yangu na yawekwe [kama] uvumba mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kuinuliwa kwa mikono yangu [kama] sadaka ya jioni.
sw.B: Maombi yangu na yasimame mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kama uvumba, mikono yangu iliyoinuliwa kama sadaka ya jioni.
sw.R: Maombi yangu na yakufikie kama moshi mtamu wa uvumba. Mikono yangu ninayoiinua {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} kwa maombi na iwe kama sadaka inayotolewa kila jioni.

es.L: Que mi oración sea puesta [como] incienso delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, el alzar de mis manos [como] la ofrenda de la tarde.
es.B: Que mi oración esté delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} como el incienso, mis manos alzadas como la ofrenda de la tarde.
es.R: Que mi oración llegue a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} como el humo agradable del incienso. Que mis manos, levantadas hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} en oración, sean como la ofrenda que se presenta cada tarde.

vi.L: Nguyện lời cầu nguyện của tôi được đặt trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [như] hương, việc giơ tay tôi lên [như] tế lễ buổi chiều.
vi.B: Nguyện lời cầu nguyện của tôi dâng lên trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như hương thơm, và đôi tay tôi giơ lên như của lễ buổi chiều.
vi.R: Nguyện lời cầu nguyện của tôi bay lên đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như làn khói thơm của hương. Nguyện đôi tay tôi giơ lên cầu nguyện cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được như của lễ dâng mỗi buổi chiều.

ko.L: 제 기도가 주님 앞에 분향처럼 세워지고, 제 손을 드는 것이 저녁 제물처럼 [되게 하십시오].
ko.B: 제 기도가 향처럼 주님 앞에 서게 하시고, 들어 올린 제 손이 저녁 제물처럼 되게 하십시오.
ko.R: 제 기도가 향긋한 향 연기처럼 주님께 올라가게 해 주십시오. 기도하며 주님께 들어 올린 제 손이 저녁마다 드리는 제물처럼 되게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Seja firmada a minha oração [como] incenso diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, o erguer das minhas mãos [como a] oferta da tarde.
pt.B: Que a minha oração esteja diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} como incenso, as minhas mãos erguidas como a oferta do fim da tarde.
pt.R: Que a minha oração chegue a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} como a fumaça perfumada do incenso. Que as minhas mãos, levantadas para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} em oração, sejam como a oferta apresentada todas as tardes.

am.L: ጸሎቴ በፊትህ እንደ ዕጣን፣ የእጆቼም አነሣሥ እንደ ማታ መሥዋዕት ይቆም።
am.B: ጸሎቴ በፊትህ እንደ ዕጣን ይቅረብ፤ ያነሣኋቸውም እጆቼ እንደ ማታ መባ ይሁኑ።
am.R: ጸሎቴ እንደ መልካም መዓዛ ያለው የዕጣን ጢስ ወደ አንተ ይድረስ። በጸሎት ወደ አንተ ያነሣኋቸው እጆቼ በየማታው እንደሚቀርበው መባ ይሁኑ።

hi.L: मेरी प्रार्थना तेरे सामने धूप [के समान] ठहरे, मेरे हाथों का उठाना साँझ की भेंट [के समान]।
hi.B: मेरी प्रार्थना तेरे सामने धूप की तरह ठहरी रहे, और मेरे उठे हुए हाथ साँझ की भेंट की तरह।
hi.R: मेरी प्रार्थना धूप के सुगंधित धुएँ की तरह तुझ तक पहुँचे। प्रार्थना में तेरी ओर उठे मेरे हाथ उस भेंट के समान हों जो हर साँझ चढ़ाई जाती है।

ru.L: Пусть будет поставлена моя молитва [как] благовоние перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}, поднятие моих ладоней [как] вечернее приношение.
ru.B: Пусть моя молитва стоит перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}, как благовоние, а мои поднятые руки — как вечернее приношение.
ru.R: Пусть моя молитва поднимается к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, как сладкий дым благовоний. Пусть мои руки, поднятые к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} в молитве, будут как приношение, которое дают каждый вечер.

ja.L: わたしの祈りが、あなたの前に香として据えられ、わたしの手のひらを上げることが、夕べのささげ物[となる]ように。
ja.B: わたしの祈りが香のようにあなたの前に立ち、上げたわたしの手が、夕べのささげ物のようであるように。
ja.R: わたしの祈りが、香をたく甘い煙のように、あなたのもとに届くように。祈りのためにあなたに上げるわたしの手が、毎夕ささげられるささげ物のようであるように。

decisions.choice: incense and the evening offering
decisions.reason: Each morning and evening incense was burned before the LORD (Exodus 30:7-8), and a lamb with a grain offering (minchah) was offered each evening (Exodus 29:38-41). The psalmist asks that his prayer be received as those offerings were. Daniel prayed at the time of the evening offering (Daniel 9:21).

decisions.choice: be set: be accepted, stand firm before God
decisions.reason: The verb (kun) means to be set firm or established: may his prayer be accepted and stand before God.

decisions.choice: lifting of my palms: raising the hands in prayer
decisions.reason: People prayed standing with hands raised and palms open toward God (28:2; 63:5; 134:2).

decisions.choice: the sweet smoke of incense
decisions.reason: Readable says what incense is: spices burned for their sweet smoke.

decisions.choice: "the evening offering" (minḥah) as "የማታ መሥዋዕት" (Literal), "የማታ መባ" (Balanced, Readable)
alternatives: "እጅ መንሻ" (the settled word for minḥah as a gift to a person)
decisions.reason: Here minḥah is the grain offering of the evening at the temple (meaning decision m1), so it is an offering, "መሥዋዕት" / "መባ", not a present.

decisions.choice: धूप; साँझ की भेंट
decisions.reason: Incense is धूप, as in Exodus in this translation; the evening offering (minchah) is named as an offering in general, साँझ की भेंट, since the line pictures the daily evening sacrifice as a whole.

decisions.choice: благовоние; вечернее приношение
decisions.reason: Incense and the evening offering of the temple (m1) are "благовоние" and "вечернее приношение" in modern words; "фимиам" and "жертва вечерняя" are the older church forms.

decisions.choice: tikkon "据えられ" (L), "立ち" (B), "届く" (R); minchat 'arev "夕べのささげ物" (L, B), "毎夕ささげられるささげ物" (R)
decisions.reason: Accepted, standing firm before God (m2); the evening offering of the temple (m1). The wish is 〜ように (Psalter rule for jussives).

source.text: שִׁיתָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה שָׁמְרָ֣ה לְפִ֑י נִ֝צְּרָ֗ה עַל־דַּ֥ל שְׂפָתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Set, YHWH, a guard for my mouth; keep watch over [the] door of my lips.

en.L: Set, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, a guard for my mouth; keep watch over [the] door of my lips.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, station a guard at my mouth; keep a sentry at the doorway of my lips.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, guard my mouth. Keep watch over my lips, so that I do not say what I should not.

fr.L: Place, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, une garde à ma bouche ; veille sur la porte de mes lèvres.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, poste une garde devant ma bouche ; mets une sentinelle à la porte de mes lèvres.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, garde ma bouche. Surveille mes lèvres, pour que je ne dise pas ce que je ne dois pas dire.

sw.L: Weka, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mlinzi kwa kinywa changu; linda mlango wa midomo yangu.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, weka mlinzi kinywani mwangu; weka askari mlangoni pa midomo yangu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ukilinde kinywa changu. Uilinde midomo yangu, nisiseme yasiyofaa.

es.L: Pon, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, guardia a mi boca; vigila [la] puerta de mis labios.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, pon un guardia a mi boca; pon un centinela a la entrada de mis labios.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuida mi boca. Vigila mis labios, para que no diga lo que no debo.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đặt người canh giữ miệng tôi; xin canh giữ cửa môi tôi.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đặt người lính canh nơi miệng tôi; xin canh gác cửa môi tôi.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin canh giữ miệng tôi. Xin canh chừng môi tôi, để tôi không nói điều không nên nói.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 입에 파수꾼을 세우시고, 제 입술의 문을 지켜 주십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 입에 보초를 세우시고, 제 입술의 문 앞에 파수꾼을 두어 지켜 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 입을 지켜 주십시오. 제가 하지 말아야 할 말을 하지 않도록 제 입술을 지켜 주십시오.

pt.L: Põe, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, uma guarda à minha boca; vigia sobre [a] porta dos meus lábios.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, coloca uma sentinela à minha boca; mantém um vigia à entrada dos meus lábios.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, guarda a minha boca. Vigia os meus lábios, para que eu não diga o que não devo.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ለአፌ ጠባቂ አኑር፤ የከንፈሮቼን በር ጠብቅ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በአፌ ላይ ዘበኛ አቁም፤ በከንፈሮቼም መግቢያ ላይ ጠባቂ አድርግ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አፌን ጠብቅ። የማይገባውን እንዳልናገር ከንፈሮቼን ጠብቅ።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरे मुँह पर पहरा बैठा; मेरे होंठों के द्वार की चौकसी कर।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरे मुँह पर एक पहरेदार खड़ा कर; मेरे होंठों के द्वार पर चौकीदार रख।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरे मुँह की रखवाली कर। मेरे होंठों पर पहरा दे, ताकि मैं वह न कहूँ जो मुझे नहीं कहना चाहिए।

ru.L: Поставь, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, стражу у моих уст; охраняй дверь моих губ.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, поставь стража у моего рта; держи часового у входа моих губ.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, охраняй мой рот. Стереги мои губы, чтобы я не сказал того, чего говорить нельзя.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの口に見張りを置き、わたしの唇の戸を守ってください。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの口に番人を立て、わたしの唇の戸口に見張りを置いてください。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの口を見張ってください。言ってはいけないことを言わないように、わたしの唇を守ってください。

decisions.choice: the door of my lips: what comes out of the mouth
decisions.reason: The mouth is pictured as a city gate with a guard on watch. The psalmist asks God to keep him from speaking evil (39:2), unlike the wicked of verse 4.

decisions.choice: door: the door itself, or its threshold
decisions.reason: The word (dal) is the door or the leaf of a door; it is found only here in this form.

decisions.choice: so that I do not say what I should not
decisions.reason: Readable says what the guard is for (m1).

decisions.choice: dal "戸" (L), "戸口" (B)
decisions.reason: The door or its threshold (m2); R says what is meant (m1, r-en-1).

source.text: אַל־תַּט־לִבִּ֨י לְדָבָ֪ר׀רָ֡ע לְהִתְע֘וֹלֵ֤ל עֲלִל֨וֹת׀בְּרֶ֗שַׁע אֶת־אִישִׁ֥ים פֹּֽעֲלֵי־אָ֑וֶן וּבַל־אֶ֝לְחַ֗ם בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not incline my heart to a thing evil, to busy [myself with] deeds in wickedness with men doing iniquity; and let me not eat of their delicacies.

en.L: Do not turn my heart to an evil thing, to busy [myself with] deeds in wickedness with {{gender:people|men}} who do iniquity; and let me not eat of their delicacies.
en.B: Keep my heart from leaning toward anything evil, from joining with wrongdoers in their wicked acts; let me not share their rich food.
en.R: Do not let me want to do anything evil. Keep me from joining wicked people in the bad things they do. Do not let me enjoy their fancy feasts.

fr.L: N’incline pas mon cœur vers une chose mauvaise, à [m’]occuper d’actions dans la méchanceté avec des {{gender:gens|hommes}} qui commettent l’injustice ; et que je ne mange pas de leurs mets délicats !
fr.B: Empêche mon cœur de pencher vers le mal, de m’associer aux malfaiteurs dans leurs actes méchants ; que je ne partage pas leurs mets raffinés !
fr.R: Ne me laisse pas avoir envie de faire le mal. Empêche-moi de me joindre aux méchants dans les mauvaises choses qu’ils font. Ne me laisse pas profiter de leurs festins.

sw.L: Usiuelekeze moyo wangu kwenye jambo baya, kujishughulisha na matendo ya uovu pamoja na watu watendao maovu; wala nisile vyakula vyao vitamu.
sw.B: Uzuie moyo wangu usielekee kitu chochote kiovu, nisijiunge na watenda maovu katika matendo yao mabaya; nisishiriki vyakula vyao vinono.
sw.R: Usiniache nitamani kutenda jambo lolote baya. Unizuie nisijiunge na watu waovu katika mabaya wanayotenda. Usiniache nifurahie karamu zao za anasa.

es.L: No inclines mi corazón a cosa mala, a ocupar[me en] obras de maldad con {{gender:gente que hace|hombres que hacen}} iniquidad; y que no coma yo de sus manjares.
es.B: Aparta mi corazón de inclinarse a lo malo, de unirme a los malhechores en sus obras perversas; que no comparta yo su comida exquisita.
es.R: No dejes que yo quiera hacer nada malo. Líbrame de juntarme con la gente malvada en las cosas malas que hace. No dejes que disfrute de sus banquetes lujosos.

vi.L: Xin đừng để lòng tôi nghiêng về điều ác, để mải mê làm những việc gian ác cùng với những kẻ làm điều tội lỗi; và xin đừng để tôi ăn những món ngon của chúng.
vi.B: Xin giữ lòng tôi khỏi nghiêng về bất cứ điều ác nào, khỏi nhập bọn với những kẻ làm ác trong các việc gian tà của chúng; xin đừng để tôi chung phần những món ngon vật lạ của chúng.
vi.R: Xin đừng để tôi muốn làm bất cứ điều ác nào. Xin giữ tôi khỏi nhập bọn với những kẻ gian ác trong những việc xấu chúng làm. Xin đừng để tôi vui hưởng những bữa tiệc sang trọng của chúng.

ko.L: 제 마음이 악한 일에 기울어, 죄악을 행하는 사람들과 함께 악한 짓을 일삼지 않게 하시고, 제가 그들의 진수성찬을 먹지 않게 하십시오.
ko.B: 제 마음이 어떤 악한 일에도 기울지 않게 하시고, 악을 행하는 자들과 어울려 악한 짓을 하지 않게 하십시오. 그들의 기름진 음식을 함께 먹지 않게 하십시오.
ko.R: 제가 악한 일을 하고 싶어 하지 않게 해 주십시오. 악한 사람들이 하는 나쁜 일에 끼지 않게 해 주십시오. 그들의 화려한 잔치를 즐기지 않게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Não inclines o meu coração para coisa má, para me ocupar [com] obras de impiedade com {{gender:pessoas|homens}} que praticam a iniquidade; e que eu não coma das suas iguarias.
pt.B: Não deixes o meu coração pender para nada que seja mau, nem me juntar aos malfeitores nos seus atos perversos; que eu não participe dos seus banquetes.
pt.R: Não me deixes querer fazer nada de mau. Não me deixes juntar-me às pessoas más nas coisas erradas que elas fazem. Não me deixes aproveitar as festas caras delas.

am.L: ዓመፅን ከሚያደርጉ ሰዎች ጋር በክፋት ሥራዎችን እሠራ ዘንድ ልቤን ወደ ክፉ ነገር አታዘንብል፤ ከጣፋጭ ምግባቸውም አልብላ።
am.B: ልቤ ወደ ክፉ ነገር እንዳያዘነብል ጠብቀኝ፤ ክፉ አድራጊዎች በሚሠሩት ክፋት ከእነርሱ ጋር እንዳልተባበር አድርገኝ፤ ከሚያማምረው ምግባቸውም አልካፈል።
am.R: ክፉ ነገር ለማድረግ እንድመኝ አትፍቀድ። ክፉ ሰዎች በሚያደርጉት መጥፎ ነገር ከእነርሱ ጋር እንዳልተባበር ጠብቀኝ። በሚያምር ግብዣቸውም ደስ እንዳይለኝ አድርግ።

hi.L: मेरे मन को किसी बुरी बात की ओर न झुकने दे, कि मैं अधर्म करनेवाले {{gender:लोगों|पुरुषों}} के साथ दुष्टता के कामों में लगूँ; और मैं उनके स्वादिष्ट भोजन में से न खाऊँ।
hi.B: मेरे मन को किसी भी बुराई की ओर झुकने से रोक, कि मैं कुकर्मियों के साथ उनके दुष्ट कामों में शामिल न होऊँ; मैं उनके स्वादिष्ट भोजन में भागी न बनूँ।
hi.R: मुझमें कुछ भी बुरा करने की इच्छा न आने दे। मुझे दुष्ट लोगों के साथ उनके बुरे कामों में शामिल होने से रोक। मुझे उनकी शानदार दावतों का आनंद न लेने दे।

ru.L: Не склоняй моё сердце к злому делу, чтобы заниматься делами нечестия с {{gender:людьми|мужами}}, делающими беззаконие; и пусть я не вкушу их лакомств.
ru.B: Удержи моё сердце, чтобы оно не склонялось ни к чему злому, чтобы я не присоединялся к злодеям в их нечестивых делах; пусть я не разделю с ними их изысканной пищи.
ru.R: Не дай мне захотеть сделать что-то плохое. Удержи меня, чтобы я не присоединился к злым людям в том плохом, что они делают. Не дай мне наслаждаться их роскошными пирами.

ja.L: わたしの心を悪いことに傾けないでください。悪を行う者たちと共に、悪のうちにわざを行うことのないように。また、彼らのごちそうを、わたしに食べさせないでください。
ja.B: わたしの心が悪いことに傾かないようにし、悪を行う者たちと一緒に悪事に加わらないようにしてください。彼らのぜいたくな食べ物を、わたしが口にすることのないようにしてください。
ja.R: わたしが悪いことをしたいと思わないようにしてください。悪いことをする人たちの仲間に入らないように、わたしを守ってください。彼らのぜいたくな宴会を楽しまないようにしてください。

decisions.choice: their delicacies: the good things the wicked enjoy
decisions.reason: To eat at someone's table was to share their life and take their side. The psalmist refuses the rewards of joining the wicked (Proverbs 4:17; 23:1-3).

decisions.choice: busy myself with deeds: take part in doings
decisions.reason: The verb and noun come from the same root ('alal): to act, to carry out deeds. Here they are deeds done in wickedness.

decisions.choice: do not incline my heart: keep me from wanting evil
decisions.reason: The psalmist asks God to guard not only his mouth (verse 3) but what he wants and loves (119:36).

decisions.choice: wrongdoers; wicked people
decisions.reason: "Men" here means people of any kind who do wrong (po'ale 'awen, as in 5:6), so Balanced and Readable name them without it.

decisions.choice: "men who do iniquity" as "ዓመፅን የሚያደርጉ ሰዎች" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "ሰዎች" means people of either sex, so the setting has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: {{gender:लोगों|पुरुषों}}
decisions.reason: The gender setting mirrors the English span; Balanced says कुकर्मी (evildoers) and Readable दुष्ट लोग, as the English does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:людьми|мужами}}
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "men" means people of any kind who do wrong; Literal shows "людьми" by default with the traditional "мужами" as the alternative, as the English does, and Balanced and Readable say "злодеи", "злые люди" without a setting.

decisions.choice: 'ishim po'alei-'awen "悪を行う者たち" (L, B), "悪いことをする人たち" (R), no gender span
decisions.reason: The English L has a people/men span; Japanese 者たち / 人たち is already inclusive. po'alei 'awen in the Psalter form (PSA-1).

source.text: יֶֽהֶלְמֵֽנִי־צַדִּ֨יק׀חֶ֡סֶד וְֽיוֹכִיחֵ֗נִי שֶׁ֣מֶן רֹ֭אשׁ אַל־יָנִ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י כִּי־ע֥וֹד וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י בְּרָעוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Let him strike me, [the] righteous — loyal love; and let him rebuke me — oil of head; not let it refuse, my head; for still my prayer [is] against their evils.

en.L: Let [the] righteous strike me — [it is] loyal love; and let {{gender:them|him}} rebuke me — [it is] oil for [the] head; let my head not refuse [it]. For still my prayer [is] against their evil deeds.
en.B: Let a righteous person strike me: that is loyal love. Let them reprove me: that is oil for my head, and may my head never refuse it. But all the while I pray against the evil they do.
en.R: If good people hit me to correct me, it is because they care about me. If they warn me, it is like a gift of oil on my head, and I will not turn it away. But I keep praying against the evil that wicked people do.

fr.L: Que [le] juste me frappe — [c’est] de l’amour loyal ; et qu’il me reprenne — [c’est] de l’huile pour [la] tête ; que ma tête ne [la] refuse pas. Car encore ma prière [est] contre leurs méchancetés.
fr.B: Qu’un juste me frappe : c’est de l’amour fidèle. Qu’il me reprenne : c’est de l’huile sur ma tête, et que ma tête ne la refuse jamais. Mais toujours je prie contre le mal qu’ils font.
fr.R: Si des gens bons me frappent pour me corriger, c’est parce qu’ils tiennent à moi. S’ils me mettent en garde, c’est comme de l’huile qu’on me verse sur la tête, et je ne la refuserai pas. Mais je continue de prier contre le mal que font les méchants.

sw.L: Mwenye haki na anipige — [ni] upendo usiokoma; na anikemee — [ni] mafuta kwa kichwa; kichwa changu kisikatae [hayo]. Kwa maana bado maombi yangu [ni] dhidi ya matendo yao maovu.
sw.B: Mtu mwenye haki na anipige: huo ni upendo usiokoma. Na anikaripie: hayo ni mafuta kwa kichwa changu, na kichwa changu kisiyakatae kamwe. Lakini wakati wote ninaomba dhidi ya maovu wanayotenda.
sw.R: Watu wema wakinipiga ili kunirekebisha, ni kwa sababu wananijali. Wakinionya, ni kama zawadi ya mafuta kichwani mwangu, nami sitayakataa. Lakini ninaendelea kuomba dhidi ya maovu ambayo watu waovu wanatenda.

es.L: Que [el] justo me golpee: [es] amor leal; y que me reprenda: [es] aceite para [la] cabeza; que mi cabeza no [lo] rechace. Porque todavía mi oración [es] contra sus maldades.
es.B: Que una persona justa me golpee: eso es amor fiel. Que me corrija: eso es aceite para mi cabeza, y que mi cabeza nunca lo rechace. Pero todo el tiempo oro contra el mal que ellos hacen.
es.R: Si la gente buena me pega para corregirme, es porque se preocupa por mí. Si me advierte, es como un regalo de aceite sobre mi cabeza, y no lo voy a rechazar. Pero sigo orando contra el mal que hace la gente malvada.

vi.L: Nguyện người công chính đánh tôi, [đó là] tình yêu thương thành tín; nguyện người ấy quở trách tôi, [đó là] dầu cho đầu; nguyện đầu tôi không từ chối [điều đó]. Vì lời cầu nguyện của tôi vẫn [chống lại] những việc ác của chúng.
vi.B: Nguyện người công chính đánh tôi: đó là tình yêu thương thành tín. Nguyện họ quở trách tôi: đó là dầu xức trên đầu tôi, và nguyện đầu tôi không bao giờ từ chối. Nhưng tôi vẫn luôn cầu nguyện chống lại những việc ác chúng làm.
vi.R: Nếu người tốt đánh tôi để sửa dạy tôi, đó là vì họ thương tôi. Nếu họ cảnh cáo tôi, đó như món quà là dầu xức trên đầu tôi, và tôi sẽ không từ chối. Nhưng tôi vẫn cứ cầu nguyện chống lại những việc ác mà kẻ gian ác làm.

ko.L: 의인이 저를 치게 하십시오 — [그것은] 한결같은 사랑입니다. 그가 저를 꾸짖게 하십시오 — [그것은] 머리에 바르는 기름이니, 제 머리가 [그것을] 거절하지 않게 하십시오. 참으로 제 기도는 여전히 그들의 악한 행위들을 거스릅니다.
ko.B: 의인이 저를 친다면 그것은 한결같은 사랑입니다. 그가 저를 꾸짖는다면 그것은 머리에 붓는 기름이니, 제 머리가 결코 그것을 마다하지 않게 하십시오. 그러나 저는 언제나 그들이 행하는 악에 맞서 기도합니다.
ko.R: 선한 사람들이 저를 바로잡으려고 저를 때린다면, 그것은 그들이 저를 아끼기 때문입니다. 그들이 저에게 경고한다면, 그것은 제 머리에 부어 주는 기름 선물과 같으니, 저는 그것을 거절하지 않겠습니다. 그러나 저는 악한 사람들이 하는 악에 맞서 계속 기도합니다.

pt.L: Que [o] justo me fira — [é] amor leal; e que ele me repreenda — [é] óleo para [a] cabeça; que a minha cabeça não [o] recuse. Pois ainda a minha oração [é] contra as maldades deles.
pt.B: Que uma pessoa justa me bata: isso é amor leal. Que ela me corrija: isso é óleo para a minha cabeça, e que a minha cabeça nunca o recuse. Mas, enquanto isso, eu oro contra o mal que eles fazem.
pt.R: Se as pessoas boas me baterem para me corrigir, é porque se importam comigo. Se elas me advertirem, é como um presente de óleo na minha cabeça, e eu não vou recusar. Mas continuo orando contra o mal que as pessoas más fazem.

am.L: ጻድቅ ይምታኝ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅር [ነው]፤ ይገሥጸኝም፤ የራስ ዘይት [ነው]፤ ራሴ አይከልክለው። ገናም ጸሎቴ በክፋታቸው ላይ [ነው]።
am.B: ጻድቅ ሰው ይምታኝ፤ ይህ ጽኑ ፍቅር ነው። ይገሥጸኝ፤ ይህ ለራሴ ዘይት ነው፤ ራሴም ፈጽሞ አይከልክለው። ነገር ግን ሁልጊዜ በሚሠሩት ክፋት ላይ እጸልያለሁ።
am.R: ደጋግ ሰዎች ሊያርሙኝ ቢመቱኝ፣ ስለሚወዱኝ ነው። ቢገሥጹኝ፣ በራሴ ላይ እንደሚፈስ የዘይት ስጦታ ነው፤ እኔም አልከለክለውም። ነገር ግን ክፉ ሰዎች በሚያደርጉት ክፋት ላይ ዘወትር እጸልያለሁ።

hi.L: धर्मी मुझे मारे, [वह] अटल प्रेम [है]; और वह मुझे डाँटे, [वह] सिर के लिए तेल [है]; मेरा सिर [उसे] अस्वीकार न करे। क्योंकि मेरी प्रार्थना अब भी उनके बुरे कामों के विरुद्ध [है]।
hi.B: कोई धर्मी व्यक्ति मुझे मारे, तो वह कृपा है; वह मुझे डाँटे, तो वह मेरे सिर के लिए तेल है, और मेरा सिर उसे कभी अस्वीकार न करे। पर मैं लगातार उनके बुरे कामों के विरुद्ध प्रार्थना करता रहता हूँ।
hi.R: यदि भले लोग मुझे सुधारने के लिए मारें, तो इसलिए कि उन्हें मेरी चिंता है। यदि वे मुझे चेतावनी दें, तो वह मेरे सिर पर तेल के उपहार जैसा है, और मैं उसे ठुकराऊँगा नहीं। पर दुष्ट लोग जो बुराई करते हैं, उसके विरुद्ध मैं प्रार्थना करता रहता हूँ।

ru.L: Пусть праведный бьёт меня — [это] неизменная любовь; и пусть он обличает меня — [это] масло для головы; пусть не отвергнет [его] моя голова. Ведь моя молитва всё ещё против их злых дел.
ru.B: Пусть праведный человек ударит меня: это милость. Пусть он упрекает меня: это масло для моей головы, и пусть моя голова никогда не отвергнет его. Но всё это время я молюсь против зла, которое они творят.
ru.R: Если хорошие люди бьют меня, чтобы исправить, они делают это потому, что заботятся обо мне. Если они предостерегают меня, это как дар масла на мою голову, и я не отвергну его. Но я продолжаю молиться против зла, которое делают злые люди.

ja.L: 正しい者がわたしを打つように――[それは]誠実。[その人が]わたしを戒めるように――[それは]頭への油。わたしの頭がそれを拒むことのないように。まことに、なおもわたしの祈りは、彼らの悪に向けられている。
ja.B: 正しい人がわたしを打つなら、それは誠実だ。その人がわたしを戒めるなら、それは頭に注ぐ油だ。わたしの頭がそれを拒むことのないように。しかし、わたしはいつも、彼らの行う悪に逆らって祈る。
ja.R: 正しい人がわたしを正すために打つなら、それはわたしを大切に思っているからだ。その人がわたしに注意するなら、それは頭に注がれる油の贈り物のようだ。わたしはそれを断らない。けれども、わたしは、悪い人たちがする悪に逆らって、祈り続ける。

decisions.choice: oil for the head: the Hebrew text
alternatives: let the oil of a sinner not anoint my head (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: This verse is hard and its text may have suffered in copying. The ancient Greek translation reads "let not the oil of a sinner anoint my head", which fits verse 4. The Hebrew text is followed here.

decisions.choice: oil for the head: a welcome kindness
decisions.reason: Oil was poured on the head of an honored guest (23:5; Luke 7:46). A rebuke from a righteous person is as welcome as that honor (Proverbs 27:6).

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, committed love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith with a bond or covenant. It is "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced and "faithful love" at Readable, as in 5:8.

decisions.choice: their evil deeds: those of the wicked
alternatives: against their evil deeds (of the righteous)
decisions.reason: "Their" most likely points back to the wrongdoers of verse 4: the psalmist keeps praying against what they do.

decisions.choice: a righteous person ... them (B); good people (R)
decisions.reason: The righteous person here is anyone who does right, so Balanced and Readable use words that include men and women.

decisions.choice: because they care about me
decisions.reason: Readable says what the loyal love of a friend who corrects means here (m3).

decisions.choice: "c'est parce qu'ils tiennent à moi" at Readable for ḥesed; "l'amour loyal" (Literal), "l'amour fidèle" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Here ḥesed names the friend's faithful care shown in a hard word. Readable says that in plain words, as the English Readable does, instead of forcing the term of the terms note into the sentence.

decisions.choice: "ni kwa sababu wananijali" (it is because they care about me) at Readable for hesed
alternatives: "ni upendo usiokoma", as at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Here the loyal love is a friend's, shown in a hard rebuke. The English Readable says what it means for the speaker, and Swahili Readable follows that sense rather than forcing the term "upendo usiokoma" into a plain sentence.

decisions.choice: no pronoun for "him" (L)
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender setting on the pronoun "them/him". Spanish leaves the subject in the verb ("que me reprenda"), which speaks of any righteous person, so no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: "người công chính", "người ấy", "họ" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English ("them"/"him")
decisions.reason: "người", "người ấy" and "họ" already cover men and women, so Vietnamese has no second form for the setting to give.

decisions.choice: Readable "그들이 저를 아끼기 때문입니다" for hesed shown by a righteous person
decisions.reason: Here the loyal love is a friend's, shown by hard correction (meaning decision); Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does ("they care about me"), rather than the Psalter's word for God's love.

decisions.choice: ele, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "them|him" for the righteous one who rebukes; Portuguese has no singular pronoun that includes both, and the generic "ele" referring back to "o justo" already means anyone, so there is no second wording to offer.

decisions.choice: ḥesed here as "ጽኑ ፍቅር" (Literal, Balanced), "ስለሚወዱኝ ነው" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The righteous person's blow is an act of committed love (meaning decision m3); Literal and Balanced keep the psalms' word for ḥesed, and Readable says "because they care about me", as the English does. The righteous is "ጻድቅ" in the third person, with no gender span, as "him" covers either sex in Amharic.

decisions.choice: अटल प्रेम (L); कृपा (B); उन्हें मेरी चिंता है (R)
decisions.reason: This is hesed between people, a friend's faithful kindness: अटल प्रेम at Literal and कृपा at Balanced, as the Pentateuch note settles; Readable says what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a span on the pronoun (them/him); the Hindi verbs मारे and डाँटे do not mark gender, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: неизменная любовь (L); милость (B)
decisions.reason: This is hesed shown by a person, a friend's committed love (m3), not God's; it takes the forms the history note settles for hesed between people, "неизменная любовь" at Literal and "милость" at Balanced; Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: праведный ... он (L); праведный человек ... он (B), no span
decisions.reason: Russian "праведный" and "человек" already include men and women, and "он" agrees with them, so no gender setting is needed where the English Literal has one and the English Balanced says "them".

decisions.choice: chesed (between people) "誠実" (L, B); R "わたしを大切に思っているから" as the English R
decisions.reason: Psalter rule: chesed between people is 誠実, not the 変わらぬいつくしみ kept for God (m3).

decisions.choice: shemen ro'sh "頭への油" (L), "頭に注ぐ油" (B), "頭に注がれる油の贈り物" (R); bera'oteihem "彼らの悪" (L), "彼らの行う悪" (B), "悪い人たちがする悪" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text is followed (m1, uncertain, footnote); oil on the head is a welcome kindness (m2); 'their' is read as the wicked of v4 (m4, uncertain).

source.text: נִשְׁמְט֣וּ בִֽידֵי־סֶ֭לַע שֹׁפְטֵיהֶ֑ם וְשָׁמְע֥וּ אֲ֝מָרַ֗י כִּ֣י נָעֵֽמוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: They have been thrown down by [the] hands of [the] rock, their judges, and they will hear my words, for they are pleasant.

en.L: Their judges have been thrown down by [the] sides of [the] cliff, and they will hear my words, for they are pleasant.
en.B: When their rulers are flung down the face of the cliff, people will hear my words and know that they were kind.
en.R: When their leaders are thrown off the cliff, people will listen to me. They will see that my words were good.

fr.L: Leurs juges ont été précipités par [les] flancs du rocher, et ils entendront mes paroles, car elles sont agréables.
fr.B: Quand leurs chefs seront jetés du haut de la falaise, on entendra mes paroles et on saura qu’elles étaient bienveillantes.
fr.R: Quand leurs chefs seront jetés du haut de la falaise, les gens m’écouteront. Ils verront que mes paroles étaient bonnes.

sw.L: Waamuzi wao wametupwa chini kando ya mwamba, nao watasikia maneno yangu, kwa maana ni matamu.
sw.B: Watawala wao watakapotupwa chini kutoka kwenye genge la mwamba, watu watasikia maneno yangu na kujua kwamba yalikuwa mema.
sw.R: Viongozi wao watakapotupwa kutoka juu ya mwamba mrefu, watu watanisikiliza. Wataona kwamba maneno yangu yalikuwa mazuri.

es.L: Sus jueces han sido arrojados por [los] lados de [la] peña, y oirán mis palabras, porque son agradables.
es.B: Cuando sus gobernantes sean despeñados por el precipicio, la gente oirá mis palabras y sabrá que eran amables.
es.R: Cuando a sus líderes los echen por el precipicio, la gente me escuchará. Verán que mis palabras eran buenas.

vi.L: Các quan xét của chúng đã bị quăng xuống bên [vách] đá, và chúng sẽ nghe lời tôi, vì [lời ấy] êm dịu.
vi.B: Khi những kẻ cầm quyền của chúng bị quăng xuống vách đá, người ta sẽ nghe lời tôi và biết rằng lời ấy là lời tử tế.
vi.R: Khi những kẻ lãnh đạo của chúng bị ném xuống vực đá, người ta sẽ lắng nghe tôi. Họ sẽ thấy lời tôi nói là tốt lành.

ko.L: 그들의 재판관들이 바위 곁으로 내던져졌으니, 그들이 제 말을 들을 것입니다. 제 말이 달콤하기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그들의 통치자들이 낭떠러지 아래로 내던져질 때, 사람들이 제 말을 듣고 그것이 친절한 말이었음을 알 것입니다.
ko.R: 그들의 지도자들이 절벽에서 내던져질 때 사람들이 제 말을 들을 것입니다. 제 말이 옳았다는 것을 알게 될 것입니다.

pt.L: Os juízes deles foram lançados pelos lados do penhasco, e ouvirão as minhas palavras, pois são agradáveis.
pt.B: Quando os seus governantes forem atirados do alto do penhasco, as pessoas ouvirão as minhas palavras e saberão que eram bondosas.
pt.R: Quando os líderes deles forem jogados do penhasco, as pessoas vão me escutar. Elas vão ver que as minhas palavras eram boas.

am.L: ፈራጆቻቸው በዓለቱ ጎን ተወረወሩ፤ ቃሌንም ይሰማሉ፤ ደስ የሚያሰኝ ነውና።
am.B: ገዢዎቻቸው ከገደሉ ቋጥኝ ቁልቁል በተወረወሩ ጊዜ፣ ሰዎች ቃሌን ይሰማሉ፤ ደግ እንደ ነበረም ያውቃሉ።
am.R: መሪዎቻቸው ከገደሉ ላይ በተጣሉ ጊዜ ሰዎች ይሰሙኛል። የተናገርሁትም መልካም እንደ ነበረ ያያሉ።

hi.L: उनके न्यायी चट्टान के किनारों से नीचे गिरा दिए गए हैं, और वे मेरे वचन सुनेंगे, क्योंकि वे मधुर हैं।
hi.B: जब उनके शासक चट्टान की खड़ी ढलान से नीचे फेंक दिए जाएँगे, तब लोग मेरी बातें सुनेंगे और जानेंगे कि वे भली थीं।
hi.R: जब उनके अगुवे चट्टान से नीचे फेंक दिए जाएँगे, तब लोग मेरी सुनेंगे। वे देखेंगे कि मेरी बातें अच्छी थीं।

ru.L: Их судьи сброшены по склонам скалы, и они услышат мои слова, ведь они приятны.
ru.B: Когда их правителей сбросят со скалы, люди услышат мои слова и поймут, что они были добрыми.
ru.R: Когда их вождей сбросят со скалы, люди будут слушать меня. Они увидят, что мои слова были хорошими.

ja.L: 彼らを裁く者たちは、岩壁のかたわらから投げ落とされた。そして彼らは、わたしの言葉を聞く。それが快いものだからである。
ja.B: 彼らの支配者たちが岩壁から投げ落とされるとき、人々はわたしの言葉を聞き、それが優しいものだったと知る。
ja.R: 彼らの指導者たちが、がけから投げ落とされるとき、人々はわたしの言うことを聞く。そして、わたしの言葉が良いものだったとわかる。

decisions.choice: a picture of judgment on the wicked rulers
alternatives: their judges were thrown down, yet they heard my words
when they fall into the hands of the Rock (God), their judges will hear
decisions.reason: This verse and the next are among the hardest in the Psalms. The likely sense is that when the leaders of the wicked are judged, others will see that the psalmist's words were true and gentle. Who "they" are who hear is not said.

decisions.choice: thrown down the cliff: a form of execution
decisions.reason: Enemies were sometimes put to death by being thrown from a cliff (2 Chronicles 25:12; Luke 4:29).

decisions.choice: their judges: their rulers
decisions.reason: The word (shofet) is a judge or ruler, here the leaders of the wicked.

decisions.choice: people will hear
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "people", since "they" cannot be the leaders who have fallen (m1).

decisions.choice: लोग
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "people", as the English does, since the hearers cannot be the leaders who have fallen.

decisions.choice: bidei-sela' "岩壁のかたわらから" (L), "岩壁から" (B), "がけから" (R); shofteihem "彼らを裁く者たち" (L), "支配者たち" (B), "指導者たち" (R)
decisions.reason: The verse is obscure (m1, uncertain); read as wicked rulers thrown down a cliff in judgment (m2, m3). B and R supply 'people' as the English does (r-en-1).

source.text: כְּמ֤וֹ פֹלֵ֣חַ וּבֹקֵ֣עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ נִפְזְר֥וּ עֲ֝צָמֵ֗ינוּ לְפִ֣י שְׁאֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: As one plowing and breaking up in the earth, they have been scattered, our bones, at [the] mouth of Sheol.

en.L: As [when] one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones have been scattered at [the] mouth of Sheol.
en.B: Like clods when the ground is plowed and broken open, our bones lie scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
en.R: Our bones are scattered at the door of the place of the dead, like lumps of earth turned up by a plow.

fr.L: Comme [quand] on laboure et qu’on fend la terre, nos os ont été dispersés à [l’]entrée du Shéol.
fr.B: Comme des mottes quand la terre est labourée et ouverte, nos os gisent dispersés à l’entrée du séjour des morts.
fr.R: Nos os sont dispersés à la porte du pays des morts, comme des mottes de terre retournées par la charrue.

sw.L: Kama [wakati] mtu anapolima na kupasua ardhi, mifupa yetu imetawanywa kinywani pa Kuzimu.
sw.B: Kama madongoa ardhi inapolimwa na kupasuliwa, mifupa yetu imetapakaa kwenye mdomo wa Kuzimu.
sw.R: Mifupa yetu imetawanyika mlangoni pa Kuzimu, mahali pa wafu, kama madongoa yanayogeuzwa na jembe.

es.L: Como [cuando] uno ara y rompe la tierra, nuestros huesos han sido esparcidos a [la] boca del Seol.
es.B: Como terrones cuando se ara y se abre la tierra, nuestros huesos yacen esparcidos a la boca del lugar de los muertos.
es.R: Nuestros huesos están esparcidos a la puerta del lugar de los muertos, como terrones que levanta el arado.

vi.L: Như khi người ta cày và xới đất, xương cốt chúng tôi đã bị rải ra nơi cửa Âm Phủ.
vi.B: Như những cục đất khi người ta cày xới ruộng, xương cốt chúng tôi nằm vương vãi nơi cửa Âm Phủ.
vi.R: Xương cốt chúng tôi nằm vương vãi ở cửa nơi của người chết, như những cục đất bị lưỡi cày lật lên.

ko.L: 사람이 땅을 갈아 부술 때처럼, 저희 뼈가 스올 입구에 흩어졌습니다.
ko.B: 땅을 갈아엎어 부서진 흙덩이처럼, 저희 뼈가 스올 입구에 흩어져 있습니다.
ko.R: 쟁기로 갈아엎은 흙덩이처럼, 저희 뼈가 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳의 문 앞에 흩어져 있습니다.

pt.L: Como [quando] alguém ara e rompe a terra, os nossos ossos foram espalhados à boca do Sheol.
pt.B: Como torrões quando a terra é arada e revolvida, os nossos ossos estão espalhados à boca do mundo dos mortos.
pt.R: Os nossos ossos estão espalhados na entrada do mundo dos mortos, como torrões de terra revirados pelo arado.

am.L: መሬትን እንደሚያርስና እንደሚገምስ፣ አጥንቶቻችን በሲኦል አፍ ተበተኑ።
am.B: መሬት ሲታረስና ሲገመስ እንደሚበተን ጓል፣ አጥንቶቻችን በሲኦል አፍ ተበትነው ተጥለዋል።
am.R: ማረሻ እንደሚገለብጠው የአፈር ጓል፣ አጥንቶቻችን በሙታን ዓለም በር ላይ ተበትነዋል።

hi.L: जैसे [कोई] भूमि को जोतता और तोड़ता है, [वैसे ही] हमारी हड्डियाँ शिओल के मुँह पर बिखेर दी गई हैं।
hi.B: जैसे भूमि जोतकर तोड़ी जाती है तो ढेले बिखर जाते हैं, वैसे ही हमारी हड्डियाँ अधोलोक के मुँह पर बिखरी पड़ी हैं।
hi.R: हमारी हड्डियाँ मृत्यु के लोक के द्वार पर बिखरी पड़ी हैं, जैसे हल चलाने से उलटे हुए मिट्टी के ढेले।

ru.L: Как [когда] пашут и разрыхляют землю, рассыпаны наши кости у входа в шеол.
ru.B: Как комья земли, когда её пашут и разбивают, наши кости лежат рассыпанные у входа в мир мёртвых.
ru.R: Наши кости рассыпаны у входа в мир мёртвых, как комья земли, которые выворачивает плуг.

ja.L: 人が地を耕し、砕くときのように、わたしたちの骨は陰府の口に散らされた。
ja.B: 地を耕して掘り起こしたときの土くれのように、わたしたちの骨は陰府の入り口に散らばっている。
ja.R: わたしたちの骨は、すきで掘り返された土のかたまりのように、死者の世界の入り口に散らばっている。

decisions.choice: our bones: the Hebrew text
alternatives: their bones (some manuscripts of the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "our bones": the psalmist and those with him are close to death. Some manuscripts of the ancient Greek translation have "their bones", which would continue the judgment of verse 6.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Sheol is the world of the dead, pictured as a mouth that swallows (Isaiah 5:14). The bones lie at its opening.

decisions.choice: like one plowing: scattered like broken earth
decisions.reason: The picture is of clods thrown up and left lying by the plow.

decisions.choice: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: As in 6:6.

decisions.choice: "Âm Phủ" (L, B); "nơi của người chết" (R), as Psalm 139:8
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of the dead (see the meaning decision); the wording follows the published Psalm 139:8.

decisions.choice: "스올" (L, B), "죽은 사람들이 있는 곳" (R), as the published Psalm 139:8; "저희" for "our"
decisions.reason: The terms note follows Psalm 139:8 for Sheol, the place of the dead (meaning decision). The verse is said to God, so the people's "our" is the humble "저희".

decisions.choice: Sheol as "ሲኦል" at Literal and Balanced here, "የሙታን ዓለም" at Readable
alternatives: "የሙታን ዓለም" at Balanced, as the terms list
decisions.reason: The English Balanced keeps "Sheol" in this line and the "mouth of Sheol" is a fixed picture of the grave's open throat; Balanced follows the English, Readable the terms list.

decisions.choice: 'atsamenu "わたしたちの骨" (Hebrew text, m1, uncertain); she'ol "陰府" (L, B), "死者の世界" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter rule for Sheol; the bones are kept as the Hebrew has them, though some read 'their bones'.

source.text: כִּ֤י אֵלֶ֨יךָ׀יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֣י עֵינָ֑י בְּכָ֥ה חָ֝סִ֗יתִי אַל־תְּעַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: For to you, YHWH [the] Lord, [are] my eyes; in you I take refuge; do not pour out my soul.

en.L: For to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} my Lord, [are] my eyes; in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I take refuge; do not pour out my soul.
en.B: But my eyes look to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}; I make {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} my refuge. Do not let my life be poured out.
en.R: But Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, I am looking to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for help. I run to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for safety. Do not let me die.

fr.L: Car vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} mon Seigneur, [sont] mes yeux ; en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} je me réfugie ; ne répands pas mon âme.
fr.B: Mais mes yeux sont tournés vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ; je fais de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} mon refuge. Ne laisse pas ma vie se répandre.
fr.R: Mais Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, je compte sur {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour m’aider. Je cours vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour être en sécurité. Ne me laisse pas mourir.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}, Ee {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} Bwana wangu, [yako] macho yangu; {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ninakimbilia; usiimwage nafsi yangu.
sw.B: Lakini macho yangu yanakutazama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}; ninakufanya {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kuwa kimbilio langu. Usiache maisha yangu yamwagwe.
sw.R: Lakini Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, ninakutazama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kwa msaada. Ninakukimbilia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ili niwe salama. Usiniache nife.

es.L: Porque hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, mi Señor, [están] mis ojos; en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me refugio; no derrames mi alma.
es.B: Pero mis ojos miran hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}; {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} hago mi refugio. No dejes que mi vida se derrame.
es.R: Pero, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, espero de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} la ayuda. Corro hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para estar a salvo. No dejes que me muera.

vi.L: Vì mắt tôi [hướng] về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Chúa của tôi; tôi nương náu nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin đừng đổ linh hồn tôi ra.
vi.B: Nhưng lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mắt tôi hướng về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; tôi nương náu nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin đừng để mạng sống tôi bị tuôn đổ ra.
vi.R: Nhưng lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi trông lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để được giúp đỡ. Tôi chạy đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để được an toàn. Xin đừng để tôi chết.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 제 주님, 제 눈이 주님을 [향합니다]. 제가 주님께 피하니, 제 영혼을 쏟아 버리지 마십시오.
ko.B: 그러나 주 {{divine_name:하나님이여|야훼여}}, 제 눈이 주님을 바라봅니다. 제가 주님을 피난처로 삼으니, 제 목숨이 쏟아져 버리지 않게 하십시오.
ko.R: 그러나 주 {{divine_name:하나님이여|야훼여}}, 저는 도움을 구하며 주님을 바라봅니다. 안전을 찾아 주님께로 달려갑니다. 제가 죽지 않게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Pois para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, meu Senhor, [estão] os meus olhos; em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me refugio; não derrames a minha alma.
pt.B: Mas os meus olhos estão voltados para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}; eu faço de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} o meu refúgio. Não deixes que a minha vida seja derramada.
pt.R: Mas, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, eu olho para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} em busca de ajuda. Eu corro para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} em busca de proteção. Não me deixes morrer.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጌታዬ ሆይ፣ ዓይኖቼ ወደ አንተ [ናቸው]፤ በአንተ እጠለላለሁ፤ ነፍሴን አታፍስሳት።
am.B: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ዓይኖቼ ግን ወደ አንተ ይመለከታሉ፤ አንተን መጠጊያዬ አደርጋለሁ። ሕይወቴ እንዲፈስስ አትተው።
am.R: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ እኔ ግን እንድትረዳኝ ወደ አንተ እመለከታለሁ። ለደኅንነቴ ወደ አንተ እሸሻለሁ። እንድሞት አትተወኝ።

hi.L: क्योंकि हे {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}, मेरे प्रभु, मेरी आँखें तेरी ओर [लगी हैं]; मैं तेरी शरण लेता हूँ; मेरे प्राण को उंडेल न दे।
hi.B: पर हे प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}, मेरी आँखें तेरी ओर लगी हैं; मैं तुझे अपना शरणस्थान बनाता हूँ। मेरे जीवन को उंडेला न जाने दे।
hi.R: पर हे प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}, मैं सहायता के लिए तेरी ओर देख रहा हूँ। मैं सुरक्षा के लिए तेरे पास दौड़ता हूँ। मुझे मरने न दे।

ru.L: Ведь к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Господь мой, [обращены] мои глаза; в {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} я ищу убежища; не изливай моей души.
ru.B: Но мои глаза обращены к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}; {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — моё прибежище. Не дай моей жизни излиться.
ru.R: Но, Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я жду помощи от {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. Я бегу к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, чтобы быть в безопасности. Не дай мне умереть.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}、わたしの目はあなたに[向かう]。わたしはあなたに身を避ける。わたしの魂を注ぎ出さないでください。
ja.B: しかし、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}、わたしの目はあなたを仰いでいる。わたしはあなたを避け所とする。わたしの命が注ぎ出されることのないようにしてください。
ja.R: しかし、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}、わたしは、あなたに助けを求めて見上げている。安全を求めて、あなたのところに逃げ込む。わたしを死なせないでください。

decisions.choice: GOD my Lord
decisions.reason: As in 140:8.

decisions.choice: pour out my soul: let my life drain away to death
decisions.reason: The verb ('arah) means to lay bare or empty out. To pour out the soul is to die (Isaiah 53:12).

decisions.choice: to you are my eyes: I look to you for help
decisions.reason: Eyes turned toward someone wait on them for help (25:15; 123:1-2).

decisions.choice: GOD my Lord (L); Lord GOD (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 140:8.

decisions.choice: do not let me die
alternatives: do not pour out my soul
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m2).

decisions.choice: "CHÚA, Chúa của tôi" (L); "Chúa là CHÚA" (B, R), as Psalm 140:8
decisions.reason: The divine name joined to the title "my Lord" takes the same wording as in Psalm 140:8.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 제 주님" (L), "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}" (B, R), as in 140:8
alternatives: the usual span (주 or 야훼) followed by 제 주님
decisions.reason: With Adonai beside the name, Korean takes 하나님 as the default form of the name so that 주 is not doubled.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}, मेरे प्रभु (L); प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 140:8.

decisions.choice: ГОСПОДИ, Господь мой (L); Владыка ГОСПОДИ (B, R)
chasiti "身を避ける" (L), "避け所とする" (B), "逃げ込む" (R); YHWH 'Adonai "{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}" one span as 140:8
decisions.reason: Psalter refuge words (PSA-1); nafshi "魂" (L), "命" (B), R as the English R 'do not let me die' (m2).

source.text: שָׁמְרֵ֗נִי מִ֣ידֵי פַ֭ח יָ֣קְשׁוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מֹקְשׁ֗וֹת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: Keep me from [the] hands of [the] trap [that] they have laid for me, and [the] snares of those doing iniquity.

en.L: Keep me from [the] hands of [the] trap [that] they have laid for me, and [from the] snares of those who do iniquity.
en.B: Guard me from the grip of the trap they have set for me, from the snares of those who do wrong.
en.R: Keep me safe from the traps they have set to catch me. Protect me from the snares of people who do evil.

fr.L: Garde-moi des mains du piège [qu’]ils m’ont tendu, et des filets de ceux qui commettent l’injustice.
fr.B: Protège-moi de l’étreinte du piège qu’ils m’ont tendu, des filets de ceux qui font le mal.
fr.R: Garde-moi des pièges qu’ils ont posés pour m’attraper. Protège-moi des filets des gens qui font le mal.

sw.L: Unilinde na mikono ya mtego [ambao] wameniwekea, na [kutoka] mitego ya watendao uovu.
sw.B: Unilinde nisinaswe na mtego walionitegea, na mitego ya watenda mabaya.
sw.R: Unilinde salama na mitego waliyoweka ili kunikamata. Unikinge na mitego ya watu wanaotenda maovu.

es.L: Guárdame de [las] manos de [la] trampa [que] me han tendido, y [de los] lazos de los que hacen iniquidad.
es.B: Guárdame de las garras de la trampa que me han puesto, de los lazos de los que hacen el mal.
es.R: Mantenme a salvo de las trampas que me han puesto para atraparme. Protégeme de los lazos de la gente que hace el mal.

vi.L: Xin gìn giữ tôi khỏi tay của cái bẫy chúng đã gài cho tôi, và [khỏi] các bẫy dò của những kẻ làm điều tội lỗi.
vi.B: Xin canh giữ tôi khỏi gọng bẫy chúng đã gài để bắt tôi, khỏi bẫy dò của những kẻ làm điều sai trái.
vi.R: Xin giữ tôi an toàn khỏi những cái bẫy chúng đã gài để bắt tôi. Xin bảo vệ tôi khỏi bẫy của những kẻ làm điều ác.

ko.L: 그들이 저를 위해 놓은 덫의 손에서, 죄악을 행하는 자들의 올무에서 저를 지켜 주십시오.
ko.B: 그들이 저를 잡으려고 놓은 덫의 손아귀에서, 악을 행하는 자들의 올가미에서 저를 지켜 주십시오.
ko.R: 그들이 저를 잡으려고 놓은 덫에서 저를 안전하게 지켜 주십시오. 악한 일을 하는 사람들의 올가미에서 저를 보호해 주십시오.

pt.L: Guarda-me das mãos da armadilha [que] armaram para mim, e [dos] laços dos que praticam a iniquidade.
pt.B: Protege-me do aperto da armadilha que prepararam para mim, dos laços dos que fazem o mal.
pt.R: Guarda-me das armadilhas que eles armaram para me pegar. Protege-me dos laços das pessoas que fazem o mal.

am.L: ከዘረጉልኝ ወጥመድ እጆች፣ ዓመፅንም ከሚያደርጉ አሽክላ ጠብቀኝ።
am.B: ከዘረጉልኝ ወጥመድ መያዣ፣ ክፉ ከሚያደርጉትም አሽክላ ጠብቀኝ።
am.R: ሊይዙኝ ካጠመዱልኝ ወጥመድ ጠብቀኝ። ክፉ ከሚያደርጉ ሰዎች አሽክላ ሰውረኝ።

hi.L: मुझे उस फंदे के हाथों से बचाए रख [जो] उन्होंने मेरे लिए लगाया है, और अधर्म करनेवालों के फंदों [से]।
hi.B: उस फंदे की पकड़ से मेरी रक्षा कर जो उन्होंने मेरे लिए लगाया है, और कुकर्मियों के फंदों से भी।
hi.R: मुझे उन फंदों से सुरक्षित रख जो उन्होंने मुझे पकड़ने के लिए लगाए हैं। बुराई करनेवाले लोगों के फंदों से मेरी रक्षा कर।

ru.L: Сохрани меня от рук западни, [которую] они поставили для меня, и [от] силков делающих беззаконие.
ru.B: Огради меня от хватки западни, которую они поставили для меня, от силков тех, кто творит зло.
ru.R: Сохрани меня от ловушек, которые они поставили, чтобы поймать меня. Защити меня от силков людей, которые делают зло.

ja.L: 彼らがわたしのために仕掛けたわなの手から、また悪を行う者たちのわなから、わたしを守ってください。
ja.B: 彼らがわたしに仕掛けたわなに捕らえられないように、悪を行う者たちのわなから、わたしを守ってください。
ja.R: わたしを捕まえようとして彼らが仕掛けたわなから、わたしを守ってください。悪いことをする人たちのわなから、わたしを守ってください。

decisions.choice: the hands of the trap: the trap's grip
decisions.reason: The trap is pictured as having hands that seize. As in 140:6, the enemies are hunters setting traps.

decisions.choice: those who do iniquity: wrongdoers
decisions.reason: As in verse 4 (po'ale 'awen).

decisions.choice: midei pach "わなの手から" (L), "わなに捕らえられないように" (B)
decisions.reason: The hands of the trap are its grip (m1); L keeps the picture.

source.text: יִפְּל֣וּ בְמַכְמֹרָ֣יו רְשָׁעִ֑ים יַ֥חַד אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עַֽד־אֶעֱבֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them fall into his nets, [the] wicked, together, while I pass by.

en.L: Let [the] wicked fall into their own nets together, while I pass by.
en.B: May the wicked be caught together in their own nets, while I make my way past.
en.R: Let all those evil people get caught in their own traps, while I get away safely.

fr.L: Que [les] méchants tombent ensemble dans leurs propres filets, tandis que moi je passe !
fr.B: Que les méchants soient pris tous ensemble dans leurs propres filets, pendant que je poursuis mon chemin !
fr.R: Que tous ces méchants soient pris dans leurs propres pièges, pendant que moi je m’échappe sain et sauf !

sw.L: Waovu na waanguke katika nyavu zao wenyewe pamoja, wakati mimi ninapita.
sw.B: Waovu na wanaswe pamoja katika nyavu zao wenyewe, nami nikipita.
sw.R: Watu hao wote waovu na wanaswe katika mitego yao wenyewe, wakati mimi ninaponyoka salama.

es.L: Que [los] malvados caigan en sus propias redes a la vez, mientras yo paso.
es.B: Que los malvados queden atrapados juntos en sus propias redes, mientras yo sigo mi camino.
es.R: Que toda esa gente malvada caiga en sus propias trampas, mientras yo escapo sano y salvo.

vi.L: Nguyện [những kẻ] ác cùng nhau sa vào lưới của chính chúng, trong khi tôi đi qua.
vi.B: Nguyện những kẻ ác cùng bị mắc vào lưới của chính chúng, còn tôi thì đi qua bình yên.
vi.R: Nguyện tất cả những kẻ gian ác ấy bị mắc vào chính cái bẫy của chúng, còn tôi thoát đi an toàn.

ko.L: 악인들은 함께 자기 그물에 빠지고, 그동안 저는 지나가게 하십시오.
ko.B: 악인들은 모두 자기 그물에 걸리고, 그사이에 저는 그곳을 지나가게 하십시오.
ko.R: 악한 사람들은 모두 자기들이 놓은 덫에 걸리고, 저는 무사히 빠져나가게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Que [os] ímpios caiam nas suas próprias redes, todos juntos, enquanto eu passo.
pt.B: Que os ímpios sejam apanhados juntos nas suas próprias redes, enquanto eu sigo o meu caminho.
pt.R: Que todas essas pessoas más caiam nas suas próprias armadilhas, enquanto eu escapo em segurança.

am.L: እኔ ሳልፍ ክፉዎች በገዛ መረባቸው በአንድነት ይውደቁ።
am.B: እኔ ስሻገር ክፉዎች በገዛ መረባቸው በአንድነት ይያዙ።
am.R: እኔ በሰላም ሳመልጥ እነዚያ ክፉ ሰዎች ሁሉ በገዛ ወጥመዳቸው ይያዙ።

hi.L: दुष्ट एक साथ अपने ही जालों में गिरें, जब तक मैं पार निकल जाऊँ।
hi.B: दुष्ट सब के सब अपने ही जालों में फँस जाएँ, और मैं बचकर आगे निकल जाऊँ।
hi.R: वे सब दुष्ट लोग अपने ही फंदों में फँस जाएँ, और मैं सुरक्षित निकल जाऊँ।

ru.L: Пусть падут нечестивые в свои же сети вместе, пока я прохожу мимо.
ru.B: Пусть нечестивые все вместе попадутся в свои же сети, а я пройду мимо.
ru.R: Пусть все эти злые люди сами попадутся в свои ловушки, а я уйду невредимым.

ja.L: 悪しき者たちは、共に自分の網に落ちるように。その間に、わたしは通り過ぎる。
ja.B: 悪しき者たちがみな一緒に自分の網に捕らえられ、その間に、わたしが通り過ぎて行けるように。
ja.R: 悪い人たちがみな、自分たちが仕掛けたわなにかかるようにしてください。そのあいだに、わたしは無事に逃げて行く。

decisions.choice: his nets: each one's own nets
decisions.reason: "His nets" is singular: each wicked person falls into the net he set for others (7:16; 9:16; 35:8).

decisions.choice: together: all of them at once
decisions.reason: The word (yachad) can go with the wicked, "all together", or with "I", "while I alone pass by".

decisions.choice: their own nets
decisions.reason: Every level says "their", since "his" here means each of the wicked (m1), not God.

decisions.choice: get away safely
decisions.reason: Readable says what passing by means here: going on unharmed.

decisions.choice: bemakhmoraw "自分の網" (L, B), "自分たちが仕掛けたわな" (R); yachad "共に" (L), "みな一緒に" (B), "みな" (R)
decisions.reason: Each one's own nets (m1); together read as all at once (m2, uncertain). Imprecation R 〜ようにしてください (Psalter rule).
